preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The size of the permutation N is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
Each element of the permutation A is between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: All elements in A are distinct
preconditions.description: The permutation A consists of all integers from 1 to N exactly once.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases won't exceed 5 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of elements across all test cases does not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: The output permutation should be the smallest possible permutation that can be achieved by applying any number of left shifts and at most two swaps.
